title: DCLab Code: live tests on the owner's budget, and who acts recorded on every act
request: You have a $20 budget to test dclab-code live: find bugs and fix them, and keep every record for training.
plan: DCLab's ML tools through the app, up to the holdout guard
A real small R&D task in its own copy, in plan mode
Two sessions at once, each in its own copy
Keep every record, fix what the runs show, report the spend

decisions.decision: Test homes and port 4318 only, never the owner's home or port 4317
decisions.why: the owner's sessions are training data; a test must never mix into them

decisions.decision: decidedBy in the config, not a guess from the clicks
decisions.why: the app cannot tell a script's click from a person's; the home that runs the test can say so

decisions.decision: Anything other than "person" counts as a script
decisions.why: a typo must fail toward no label, never toward a gold one
the SDK can only move them inside the project (into the repository); the plan text is recorded whole anyway

change: config decidedBy; LiveSession.who(); by on user_message, permission, question and plan decisions, feedback, person commands, undo, outcomes (committed, merged, copy_removed) and stop; the app's own denies stay app; state.decidedBy and a status-line warning; Keep planning with an empty box asks for the change and sends nothing, and the error goes once the plan is answered.

findings.defect: a test script's clicks were recorded as the person's
findings.scenario: batch 1's page script allowed 9 DCLab steps and graded a turn Good; every record said by: "person"
findings.cause: only two actors existed, the person and the app
findings.fix: decidedBy: "script" in a test home puts by: "script" on every act

findings.defect: Keep planning with an empty box sent the agent no direction
findings.scenario: the plan card's Keep planning pressed before typing: the agent got 'the person did not approve this plan yet' and had to ask what to change
findings.cause: the button sent whatever the box held, even nothing
findings.fix: an empty box shows 'Say what to change first' and sends nothing
findings.test: tests/page.test.js: the question card and the plan card answer the agent

findings.defect: the 'say what to change' error stayed on the card after the plan was approved
findings.scenario: Keep planning with an empty box, then Approve: the card said Approved and still showed the error
findings.cause: a successful send never cleared it
findings.fix: cleared before sending and removed when the plan is answered
findings.test: tests/page.test.js: the question card and the plan card answer the agent

findings.defect: the test-home test covered six record types of twelve
findings.scenario: a plan choice, an answer, an undo, a merge, a copy removal or a stop recorded as the person's would have passed
findings.cause: the test stopped after the commit
findings.fix: the test plays every act and asserts each record's by; only the app's deny at the stop is the app's

measurements.name: live tests with real models
measurements.gate: the holdout guard asks with no always option; plan card, question card and edit asks work on a real task; two copies stay apart; each batch's spend reported
measurements.result: all held: guard 1 asked, 1 allowed (Y key); the fix made in plan mode in its own copy passed its test; two copies held only their own files; remove refused unsaved work, then removed when forced
limits: the owner did not click: a script did

measurements.name: dclab-code tests
measurements.gate: every server, unit and page test passes, none skipped; the new test fails without who()
measurements.result: 52 passed, 0 skipped; the test-home test fails when who() returns person

outcome: The live tests found two bugs, both fixed; a test home now says in every record that a script acted.
lessons: A test that clicks for the person is itself an actor: the record must name it
Give the tool under test a real job: plan mode, the question card and the edit asks were exercised on a fix worth having
risks: the session's cost shows $0 until a turn ends (the SDK reports cost then)
